title: Qcqs pushforward cohomology preserves the localization unit telescope
statement: For a qcqs scheme map f:X→Y, a bounded-below derived integral coefficient object K on X, and q∈ℤ, the composite Rf_* followed by qth derived cohomology sends the canonical lifted localization unit cocone of K to a colimit cocone. Definitions and notation: [def-weil-pbc-integral-localization-telescope], [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qcqs-pushforward-continuity].

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), referring to Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.8.2; scalar localization telescope

proof.text: Use the strict complex localization model and colimit transport. Every term of its scalar telescope has the same strict lower bound. Apply condensed_qcqs_pushforward_continuity at that bound; its canonical comparison being invertible makes the mapped good-truncation cocone colimiting.

proof_origin.note: B2: explicit scalar telescope construction and categorical compatibility. This auxiliary declaration is proved in the delivery, not a new assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem integralLocalization_push_homology_isColimit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)))
    (hK : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus K) (q : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (((lowerStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).mapCocone
      (integralLocalizationLiftedCocone.{u, u + 1} ℓ E X K)))
